title: Night Watch
core_verb: Check camera feeds to track approaching animatronics and close the corresponding office door before they enter.
fantasy: A lone night guard monitors a small building from a fixed security office while hostile animatronics approach through two corridors.
fail_state: An animatronic enters the office while its corridor door is open, setting player health from 1 to 0.
win_state: Remain alive until the 120-second night clock reaches 6:00 AM.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hostile moving between camera nodes; entering the office through an open door reduces player health to zero.
Collectible visible on a camera feed that restores 20 units to the office's 100-unit power supply.
Goal clock that completes when the 120-second night timer elapses, ending the shift in victory.

notes: The multi-night game is reduced to one two-minute shift with two corridor doors, a finite 100-unit power supply, scripted animatronic movement between camera nodes, and a single-health fail state.

scene.description: A cramped security office lit only by monitor screens, two heavy doors flanking the desk. Four camera feeds show dim corridors, a power meter glows on the wall, and a clock ticks toward 6 AM in the corner. The player never leaves the desk, so the space is fixed by the mechanic rather than laid out; desk clutter and door buttons are the only props.
